reviews.comments:
26C rua Garrett is a lovely, spacious, well-appointed apartment, with a folder containing lots of useful information. The biggest asset, however, is the central location, with easy access to everything. Hosts Sam and Kim were very helpful, but we only met Kim. We had a problem with the boiler the first day but Kim came immediately and was able to sort it.
Our hosts recommended the nearby restaurant, Casa da India, and we totally agree! Despite the name it is a good value Portuguese restaurant. Another hosts’ recommendation a few doors away from Casa da India is Sea Me. More expensive but great food and wonderful service from the bartender and the maître d’. We recommend the last two seats at the bar – best seats in the restaurant. The flat was more expensive than we normally like to pay but the flat was excellent and you pay for the location and good hosts.

We had a lovely stay at Sam and Kim -
Communication was easy and Sam gave some good recommendations on restaurants close by ..the apartment was perfect and very comfortable and has all the amenities to make a pleasant stay with ample clothes hangers, body wash and shampoo and laundry tablets plus international adapters with chargers sockets ! A big plus ! We were greeted by Alex who explained everything clearly! The guide/ playbook is very good and one of the best we have seen ! The apartment was very clean as well and we were happy there was 2AC’s in the apartment! We had issues with logging into to wifi but after a quick conversation with Kim and resetting the router .. we connected straight away! We appreciate the prompt reply ! We had a lovely stay and would encourage anyone wanting a space which is well equipped and tastefully decorated to stay here in Lisbon !

Alex checked us in and gave us a clear orientation about the place and surroundings. She was welcoming and energetic though it was already late at night.
I am big on location, and this was spot on. The reason for the drop of the missing star in the review was the problematic gas boiler that left us without hot water at certain times of the day, and water can randomly turn cold in the middle of a shower. My husband resets the system, so we’re able to manage.
Otherwise, I can recommend the place to others looking for the best place in Lisbon. It’s within short walking distance to the metro station and the must-see places in town.

reviews.comments:
Very nice apartment in a busy, bustling area. Could barely hear any noise from the street below when the windows were closed, and none when the shutters were closed.
Very close to lots of restaurants and shops. The best delicatessens and supermarkets were only a 10 minute walk. It was an easy walk to the river and major sites, but the walk back has a few steepish hills, there is an elevator in the shopping mall close by that helps.
The apartment is not huge, but still a good size for two people. The bedroom is a very generous size. Shower was very good with good pressure.
The only down-side with the apartment was that there is no freezer, just a half-size fridge.

I had the perfect week’s stay at Sam’s apartment. Despite being on a busy street, the apartment was incredibly quiet, and the blackout bedroom was much appreciated for a comfortable night’s sleep. The bed was excellent as well!
The apartment had everything we needed, including a well-equipped kitchen for cooking, and the laundry facilities, dishwasher, and bidet were wonderful bonuses. The shower had great water pressure, and the air conditioning worked perfectly.
Sam was a fantastic host—very communicative, and both check-in and navigating the apartment were a breeze. The metro is just steps away, with plenty of restaurants nearby, making it an ideal location for exploring the city on foot and by public transportation.
I highly recommend staying here!

We have stayed in numerous flats in various parts of Europe and this is one of the very best!
